title: CRASH-068: register constant redefine frees name before error message uaf (use-after-free)
live_proof: measured, not asserted: our native ASan build of the pinned 5.0.0 tarball (p12, gcc 15.2.0, libasan from gcc 15, 2026-10-27) reports ASAN:heap-use-after-free at main/spprintf.c:518 in xbuf_format_converter when trigger.php runs; the corpus records the fix as php-src 1ea22c90046bc51543dd5a606ff83823056654a1, which postdates the release, and names the defect at Zend/zend_constants.c:320
fidelity: the corpus's own trigger script, run through the real interpreter (PHP's cli SAPI, ext/standard only, the port's 145 translation units) rather than reduced to a C model. What it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it. The pristine build completes it natively, so an arm that completes it saw nothing.
fault_sites_why: ASan's access stack in our native run (results-ours-asan-default.json, sha256 045e3366bfc5) has xbuf_format_converter at main/spprintf.c:518 as its first frame inside PHP's tree (frame #1, under the libc leaf strlen at frame #0, which is not declared: a fault there can be tied to this case only through its caller, and the launcher reports no return address); the stack's remaining frames are the interpreter's dispatch and are not sites

virtual-malloc.oracle: the case on the virtual profile with the seam present but returning every freed block's loan, so only musl mallocng revokes, per BLOCK, when PHP's cache hands a block back to free(): a fault at the ASan site, or the trigger ends and this arm did not see it (tools/arms.json php-real-block)
